_comment: GENERATED by scripts/check_config_field_consumers.py -- do not hand-edit. Admitted TRWConfig fields, published into the wheel so a consumer of the released package can act on them (PRD-QUAL-131-FR05). Read via trw_mcp.models.config.unread_config_fields(). 'unread_fields' lists fields with NO reader anywhere this repository can measure: setting one in .trw/config.yaml or as a TRW_* variable changes nothing, and an eval variant that ablates on one runs un-ablated under an ablated label. 'externally_consumed_fields' is the class that assertion is FALSE for (PRD-CORE-263-FR10): the Python scan cannot see their reader, but one exists at the cited path:line -- a shell hook, a generated instruction file, another package -- so setting them DOES change behaviour and an ablation on one is real. They are deliberately excluded from 'unread_fields'.
